card.name: The word Healthcare before providers
card.fires_on: The word "Healthcare" (or "healthcare") when it begins a sentence or bullet addressed to providers, mostly in REMS and registry notices. It also fires on "healthcare" before "providers" or "settings".

modes.label: Sentence-opening Healthcare
modes.description: "Healthcare" starts a sentence or bullet telling providers to complete training or register patients.
modes.example: Opioid Analgesic Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS)<< Healthcare>> providers are strongly encouraged to complete a REM

modes.label: Healthcare within a sentence
modes.description: Lowercase "healthcare" sits before "providers" or "settings" in the middle of a sentence.
modes.example: drug companies with approved opioid analgesic products must make REMS-compliant education programs available to<< healthcare>> providers.

card.plain: It lights up on the word "Healthcare" in notices that address providers directly, such as REMS training and pregnancy registry text.
